data.one_liner: Display custom elegant toast notifications with built-in animations and themes.
data.what_it_does: Cherry Toast allows developers to show styled notification toasts with icons, titles, descriptions, and action buttons in Flutter. It supports custom animations, top and bottom positions, RTL layouts, and auto-dismissal.
use_when: You need elegant toast notifications with built-in icons and preset themes (success, error, warning, info).
You require customizable entrance animations and positions for your app's temporary alerts.
avoid_when: You need native system-level push notifications or background notification channels.
You need a complex snackbar replacement that integrates heavily into Scaffold state without overlays.
strengths: Multiple built-in themes and types (success, error, warning, info).
Configurable entry animations and custom durations.
Supports RTL layout rendering and customizable dimensions.
weaknesses: Limited to custom toast widgets rather than full system notifications.
Deprecated icon attribute requires transitioning to iconWidget in version 1.13.0.

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want simple native-style toasts across mobile platforms with minimal setup.

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a highly extensible toast and overlay management solution.
